page.notes: The Greek words "ἀεργίαν" and "ἀνθρωπολάτρης" (the latter read as "ἀνθρωπολάτρης" with [?]) and "εἰ δύναιντο σχολάζειν" are uncertain at this scan resolution. "Judaïzare" is printed with a damaged ligature after "Judaïz". The catchword "ftia-" is the hyphenated start of the next word on the foot line.
